text.en: Many clients commend the veterinary team for their dedication, highlighting clinicians who stayed past closing hours during emergencies and patiently treated frightened pets. However, several reviewers report serious concerns, including a chaotic handoff where a pet was temporarily given to another client, and friction during large dog intake.

title.en: Inexpensive spay rates with penalty fees

text.en: Reviewers frequently praise the low overall costs for spaying, neutering, and routine vaccinations, with some clients receiving free or subsidized procedures. Conversely, multiple visitors express frustration over unexpected costs, citing a strict one-hundred-dollar late fee for minor arrival delays and charges for unperformed services.

title.en: Lengthy intake waits and scheduling delays

text.en: Pet owners report noticeable delays during check-in and pickup, with some clients waiting over an hour to register and more than ninety minutes for intake. While occasional visits move quickly, multiple reviewers advise arriving well ahead of time due to prolonged registration lines and pickup delays.

q.en: Are low-cost spay and neuter services available here?

a.en: Yes, the clinic provides subsidized sterilization surgeries, with multiple clients reporting voucher-assisted care.

q.en: Does the clinic enforce late arrival fees?

a.en: Reviewers report a strict late fee of up to one hundred dollars if owners arrive past their designated intake check-in window.

q.en: Can blood test results from external clinics be used?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that the clinic accepted pre-operative blood work completed by their primary veterinarians.

q.en: What parking is available at the facility?

a.en: Reviewers note that the facility provides ample parking space conveniently situated off the local freeway.
